data.seo_title: Exterior Trim Repair on Cape Cod | Castro Finish Carpentry
data.seo_description: Exterior trim repair on Cape Cod: rotted fascia, soffits, corner boards and window trim fixed with tight joints. Free on-site estimate: (508) 566-1618.
data.lead: Rot repair, fascia and soffits, corner boards and window trim, with clean lines, tight joints and a clear estimate. Free on-site visit.
data.image_alt: Cedar shingle wall with balcony and fresh exterior trim
data.image2_alt: White colonial with crisp window trim and black shutters
data.summary: Repairs, replacement and detailed finishing inside and out. Straight lines, tight joints, clean transitions, and hidden rot fixed before we close up.
data.why:
On a Cape Cod house, trim takes the first hit from wind-driven rain and salt air. Leaks start at the corners, seams and transitions. Once moisture gets behind a board, it slowly softens the wood and framing underneath.

That's why we don't just nail new boards over old problems. We open it up, fix what's underneath, and then install trim that's fitted, fastened, and sealed to last.

points.text: Stops water at corners, seams and transitions
Prevents hidden rot from reaching the framing
Protects fascia and soffits from constant moisture
Closes gaps that let insects and animals in
Helps paint and siding last longer

data.seo_title: ADU Builder on Cape Cod, MA | Castro Finish Carpentry
data.seo_description: ADU builder on Cape Cod: garage conversions, in-law suites and backyard cottages, now allowed by right in Massachusetts. Free estimate: (508) 566-1618.
data.lead: Turn unused space into a fully independent living unit: garage conversions, in-law suites and backyard cottages, with a clear estimate and a finish you'll be proud of.
data.image_alt: Small cedar shingle cottage on Cape Cod
data.image2_alt: Cottage interior with new windows and finished walls
data.summary: Garage conversions, in-law suites, attached additions and backyard cottages, now allowed by right in most Massachusetts single-family zones.
data.why:
An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a small, independent home on the same lot as your main house, with its own kitchen, bathroom and entrance. It works for aging parents, adult children, guests or long-term rental income.

Since February 2025, Massachusetts law allows one ADU by right in single-family zoning districts. A building permit and code compliance are still required, and towns can set local rules on things like setbacks and parking.

points.text: Up to 900 sq ft, or half the size of the main home, whichever is smaller
No special permit required in single-family zones
No owner-occupancy requirement under state law
Building permit and code compliance still required
